hanzi: 我会说华语，还会读故事书。
pinyin: wǒ huì shuō huá yǔ, hái huì dú gù shi shū
english: I can speak Mandarin and can also read storybooks.

hanzi: 来来来，来吃草，小黑马喜欢吃草。
pinyin: lái lái lái, lái chī cǎo, xiǎo hēi mǎ xǐ huan chī cǎo
english: Come, come, come and eat grass. The little black horse likes eating grass.

hanzi: 来来来，来游泳，小黄鸭喜欢游泳。
pinyin: lái lái lái, lái yóu yǒng, xiǎo huáng yā xǐ huan yóu yǒng
english: Come, come, come and swim. The little yellow duck likes swimming.

hanzi: 绿绿的草地上，大黄牛在吃草，小白羊也在吃草。
pinyin: lǜ lǜ de cǎo dì shàng, dà huáng niú zài chī cǎo, xiǎo bái yáng yě zài chī cǎo
english: On the green grass, the big yellow cow is eating grass, and the little white sheep is eating grass too.
it is light now; day has broken

hanzi: 天亮了，红红的太阳出来了。
pinyin: tiān liàng le, hóng hóng de tài yáng chū lái le
english: Day has broken; the red sun has come out.

pinyin: wǒ men kāi kāi xīn xīn qù xué xiào

hanzi: 天黑了，弯弯的月亮在天上。
pinyin: tiān hēi le, wān wān de yuè liang zài tiān shàng
english: It is dark; the curved moon is in the sky.

pinyin: wān wān de yuè liang xiàng xiǎo chuán
english: The curved moon looks like a little boat.

pinyin: cǎo méi dàn gāo zhēn xiāng
english: The strawberry cake smells so good!

pinyin: qiǎo kè lì niú nǎi zhēn tián
english: The chocolate milk is so sweet!

pinyin: yòu xiāng yòu tián wǒ xǐ huan

hanzi: 我有圆形的饼干、正方形的饼干，还有三角形的饼干。
pinyin: wǒ yǒu yuán xíng de bǐng gān, zhèng fāng xíng de bǐng gān, hái yǒu sān jiǎo xíng de bǐng gān
english: I have round biscuits, square biscuits, and triangular biscuits too.

hanzi: 桌子上有香香的菜、香香的肉，还有香香的白米饭。
pinyin: zhuō zi shàng yǒu xiāng xiāng de cài, xiāng xiāng de ròu, hái yǒu xiāng xiāng de bái mǐ fàn
english: On the table there are fragrant vegetables, fragrant meat, and fragrant white rice too.

pinyin: yuán yuán de yuè liang zài tiān shàng
english: The round moon is in the sky.

pinyin: yuán yuán de yǎn jing zài liǎn shàng
english: The round eyes are on the face.

pinyin: yuán yuán de pú tao zài zhuō zi shàng
english: The round grapes are on the table.
at the foot of the mountain

pinyin: gāo gāo de dà shù zài shān shàng
english: The tall, big tree is on the mountain.

hanzi: 轰隆隆，轰隆隆，长长的火车在山下。
pinyin: hōng lóng lóng, hōng lóng lóng, cháng cháng de huǒ chē zài shān xià
english: Rumble, rumble! The long train is at the foot of the mountain.

hanzi: 我的妹妹在睡觉，请安静。
pinyin: wǒ de mèi mei zài shuì jiào, qǐng ān jìng
english: My younger sister is sleeping; please be quiet.

hanzi: 爸爸和妈妈在客厅看书。
pinyin: bà ba hé mā ma zài kè tīng kàn shū
english: Dad and Mum are reading in the living room.

hanzi: 我和弟弟在房间玩积木。
pinyin: wǒ hé dì di zài fáng jiān wán jī mù
english: My younger brother and I are playing with building blocks in the room.

pinyin: mèi mei bù huì xiě, zhǐ huì dú
english: Younger sister cannot write; she can only read.

hanzi: 弟弟不会穿鞋子，只会穿袜子。
pinyin: dì di bù huì chuān xié zi, zhǐ huì chuān wà zi
english: Younger brother cannot put on shoes; he can only put on socks.

pinyin: shuō shuo kàn, zhè xiē qiú shì shén me yán sè
english: Try saying it: what colours are these balls?

hanzi: 我想要吃香香的肉，请帮我找出来吧！
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yào chī xiāng xiāng de ròu, qǐng bāng wǒ zhǎo chū lái ba
english: I want to eat the fragrant meat. Please help me find it!

hanzi: 玩具火车在哪里？请找一找。
pinyin: wán jù huǒ chē zài nǎ lǐ? qǐng zhǎo yi zhǎo
english: Where is the toy train? Please look for it.
